name: LuaDNS DNS Plugin
description: DNS-01 challenge validation provider using LuaDNS. Implements the IDomainValidator interface to create, manage, and clean up DNS TXT records in LuaDNS-hosted zones for ACME domain validation. Authenticates via HTTP Basic auth using the account's username (email) and API key.

dns_provider_config.Name: LuaDns_Username
dns_provider_config.Description: LuaDNS account username (email address) used for HTTP Basic authentication.

dns_provider_config.Name: LuaDns_ApiKey
dns_provider_config.Description: LuaDNS API key used for HTTP Basic authentication. Found under Account > API Keys in the LuaDNS dashboard.
